name: Miyamae Mia
source:
Part-time job: Maid cafe
Hobbies: Rat extermination, climbing trees, chasing
Special skill: Snatching food from the maid cafe?
Favorite phrase: "Fish! Fish! Fish! Nyan"

Mia is actually a cat turned human, but Kazuya tries to keep it a secret from everybody else. She was the cat Kazuya saved from a dog during his first night at the dorm. 

Belongs to [url=/c4278]Natsuki[/url]'s group of friends.
